This did not prevent migraines.  It did give me a low energy syndrome and reduced my athletic output by 25%. People try to say this is a performance enhancing drug for golfers.  The drug made me easily irritated, weaker and more mistake prone.  This would not help performance in any way I can see.
[Reported Dose: "25 mg 3 times a day"]
